# Breakout Candidates

**Summary.** In our league, a real breakout needs a confirmed opening: a departed teammate, more minutes, or a year-two or year-three step. It should then show up in assist rate, free throw rate and efficiency at volume. Spend mid-round money on players whose opening is already in place but not yet in their price, such as Reaves, Buzelis, Dejounte Murray, Garland, Miller and Ausar Thompson. Spread your last dollars over 1 to 3 USD flyers whose minutes you check in the first two weeks.

## Breakouts come from openings

Usage carries over from one season to the next at a rate of 0.83, and minutes per game at 0.78. A player rarely jumps on his own. Look for a role change instead: an injury, a trade or a free agent departure that frees up shots. Big busts and breakouts mostly come from injuries and random shooting seasons, not from slow growth in counting stats. ([08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=534), [08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=436))

When a team loses high-usage players and brings in fewer than it lost, the leftover usage has to go somewhere. A player who was third in line to handle the ball next to two stars can jump once one star leaves, mostly in assist rate. Austin Reaves with LeBron gone is the clearest case in our pool. Check his splits from games he played next to only one of the two stars. ([07-01](https://youtu.be/W3THnI7wWdA?t=855), [07-01](https://youtu.be/W3THnI7wWdA?t=892), [Austin Reaves](../profiles/players/austin-reaves.md))

Check the usage picture before you bid. More high-usage players on one roster means fewer chances, not more. Charlotte lost Ball and Bridges, but Miller, Reid, Knueppel and White all expect more shots from that same opening. They cannot all hit their best case. ([07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=783), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [Naz Reid](../profiles/players/naz-reid.md), [Kon Knueppel](../profiles/players/kon-knueppel.md), [Coby White](../profiles/players/coby-white.md))

A player's best breakout chance is the season with the most opening. When stars come back, expect a step back. Some openings in our pool only last until a player returns. The Clippers' extra shots go to Garland, Hachimura and Strus while Ingram is out. Maluach starts only while Mark Williams is out. Isaiah Jackson starts until Konan Niederhäuser returns. ([07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=1030), [Darius Garland](../profiles/players/darius-garland.md), [Rui Hachimura](../profiles/players/rui-hachimura.md), [Max Strus](../profiles/players/max-strus.md), [Khaman Maluach](../profiles/players/khaman-maluach.md), [Isaiah Jackson](../profiles/players/isaiah-jackson.md))

## Year two and year three

In recent years the big breakouts have moved to year two, so expect second-year players to step forward. Players who did not take that step in year two are the ones who tend to break out in year three. Young players usually get more usage and minutes each year, from a small rookie role to a bigger one by year three. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=139), [09-10](https://youtu.be/W-R1dzem32s?t=1602), [08-18](https://youtu.be/FxaSnyk9g90?t=1179))

Our data tags Flagg, Coward, Dëmin and Murray-Boyles as second-year jumps. It tags Buzelis, Ware and Ausar Thompson as third-year steps. Flagg's step is already in his price, so the profit sits with the cheaper names. ([Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [Cedric Coward](../profiles/players/cedric-coward.md), [Egor Dëmin](../profiles/players/egor-demin.md), [Collin Murray-Boyles](../profiles/players/collin-murray-boyles.md), [Matas Buzelis](../profiles/players/matas-buzelis.md), [Kel'el Ware](../profiles/players/kelel-ware.md), [Ausar Thompson](../profiles/players/ausar-thompson.md))

Big jumps in year four are unlikely for players who showed nothing in their first three years. A veteran turning 29 is probably who he is. When a veteran's role grows, pay for the extra minutes, not for growth. The year rules are only a baseline. Judge each player on his own situation. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=157), [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=837), [08-26](https://youtu.be/sTtFUy7IoJI?t=2034))

## Category signals to check

Category-league breakouts are driven by efficiency at volume, a higher free throw attempt rate and a higher assist rate. Points leagues reward these less, so they matter more for us. The same two signs, more free throws and more assists, mark year-three and year-four leaps even for players who are not point guards. ([09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=360), [06-30](https://youtu.be/4GDfg2n2l8o?t=258), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1325))

The size of the jump matters. Going from about 4 free throw attempts a game to 6.5 or 7 can move a player from around 25th to around 5th. Our FG% and FT% are team ratios, so volume decides how much a player moves them. Naz Reid's 45.9% FG on about 13 attempts and Dëmin's 39.9% FG need to improve, or the extra shots will cost us. ([06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1354), [Naz Reid](../profiles/players/naz-reid.md), [Egor Dëmin](../profiles/players/egor-demin.md))

Small gains add up. A few points better from three, a bit more usage, an extra assist and more minutes can move a player into the top 50. A good per-game rank earned in limited minutes also points to upside if the minutes grow. Ware has top 40 upside at 30 minutes. Paul Reed has top 50 upside if Duren misses time. ([08-12](https://youtu.be/p9XE5jFqhvs?t=2006), [09-21](https://youtu.be/egRrai3Ax38?t=1036), [Kel'el Ware](../profiles/players/kelel-ware.md), [Paul Reed](../profiles/players/paul-reed.md))

## Where the experts disagree

One note says busts and breakouts mostly come from injuries and random shooting, not from changes in counting stats. Other notes say rising free throw and assist rates predict real star leaps. Our approach: pay for openings that already exist, such as completed departures and projected minutes. Do not pay in advance for the rate climb. Treat it as the early-season sign that the breakout is real. ([08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=436), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=360), [06-28](https://youtu.be/RsjGTgJiKyI?t=1325))

The experts also split on Naz Reid. Some project a top 50 finish after he finished 98th. Others see no upside beyond his tier. His price settles it: he is worth 15 to 20 USD as a mid-round starter, but do not pay for the top 30 hype. ([Naz Reid](../profiles/players/naz-reid.md))

## How to use this in our auction

On 2026-10-18, spend mid-round money only where the opening is confirmed and the market has not priced it in yet. Reaves, Buzelis, Dejounte Murray, Garland, Miller, Ausar Thompson and Paul George fit that. Players whose growth is already in the price, like Flagg, Tatum and Giannis, give little profit. Set a cap and let others go higher. ([Austin Reaves](../profiles/players/austin-reaves.md), [Matas Buzelis](../profiles/players/matas-buzelis.md), [Dejounte Murray](../profiles/players/dejounte-murray.md), [Darius Garland](../profiles/players/darius-garland.md), [Brandon Miller](../profiles/players/brandon-miller.md), [Ausar Thompson](../profiles/players/ausar-thompson.md), [Paul George](../profiles/players/paul-george.md), [Cooper Flagg](../profiles/players/cooper-flagg.md), [Jayson Tatum](../profiles/players/jayson-tatum.md), [Giannis Antetokounmpo](../profiles/players/giannis-antetokounmpo.md))

Fill your last roster spots with 1 to 3 USD year-two bets and minutes bets that could end up inside the 144 drafted players. Use one of the 4 IL slots for a stash like Ingram. Players outside the pool, like Paul Reed, Pelle Larsson and Konan Niederhäuser, belong on waivers or IL, not in the auction. ([Brandon Ingram](../profiles/players/brandon-ingram.md), [Paul Reed](../profiles/players/paul-reed.md), [Pelle Larsson](../profiles/players/pelle-larsson.md), [Yanic Konan Niederhäuser](../profiles/players/yanic-konan-niederhauser.md))

In the first two weeks, check three things for each breakout pick: minutes, usage, and whether assists and free throw attempts are rising. Waivers run daily on FAB with up to 6 adds a week, so drop a flyer whose minutes do not show up. Before the 2027-03-04 trade deadline, sell players whose opening ends when a star returns, because they will step back. ([08-09](https://youtu.be/8d--aL_xxwE?t=534), [09-07](https://youtu.be/gJUBAJaHzlU?t=360), [07-30](https://youtu.be/TiiaNZCJNs8?t=1030))
